products.title: 12V 2kW Diesel Heater
products.body_html:
You'll never have to avoid camping during the cold winter months with this quiet and efficient Aussie Traveller diesel powered heater. This compact designed 12V 2kW heater has excellent fuel efficiency and power consumption. You won’t even notice that this whisper quiet heater is running in your caravan or RV, so you can enjoy the warmth while your chatting away, listening to music or watching TV.

Equipped with Automatic Altitude Adjustment, it has a working height all the way up to 5000m above sea level. The heater is essentially a small fuel furnace controlled by a single-chip microprocessor. Its furnace body (the heat exchanger) is located in the hood shaped case, which serves as an independent air passage. Cold air is drawn into the air passage by the fan, heated by the heat exchanger and blown out as hot air.

Featuring an easy-to-read digital display and complete with an installation kit, you can quickly warm up your caravan or RV on those chilly winter days.

10L Diesel Fuel Tank sold separately.

Features:
  • Warms your vehicle
  • Compact design
  • Automatic altitude adjustment
  • Flexible installation with 90° tilt
  • Whisper quiet
  • Easy-to-use digital display
  • Diesel Fuel Tank not included. Sold separately.

The Aussie Traveller 41.5 inch LED light bar throws 13,000 lumens of light, providing incredible visibility when you need it most, on and off-road. Built solid, IP68 rated and made of rugged black cast aluminium & clear polycarbonate lenses.

Our light bars are best used when light is required at distance, particularly on open roads while travelling at speed, to provide visibility for upcoming obstacles, wildlife or road conditions.

For those driving at lower speeds or on enclosed roads, our range of light bars offer a better spread of light, providing you visibility off the edges of the road. Choosing to add both a lightbar and driving lights to your vehicle will give you the best of both worlds.

  • 60 x 3W LED's
  • 800m / 1 Lux of light distance
  • IP68 rated
  • Water, dust and grime proof
  • 15G vibration resistance level
